entities.summary: Scott Maurice Robertson is a former New Zealand rugby union coach and player. Nicknamed "Razor", he played as a flanker for Bay of Plenty, Perpignan, Canterbury and the Crusaders. He won 23 international caps for New Zealand between 1998 and 2002.
